latestVersion.changelog:
video-editor-pkg 1.0.0

- Initial release of an AI-powered video editing and export package.
- Upload raw video clips (MP4, MOV, AVI, WebM, up to 500MB), describe your edit, and export finished 1080p MP4.
- No manual editing required — handles trimming, transitions, text, and audio via cloud rendering.
- Built-in authentication: auto-generates free 7-day tokens for quick start.
- Supports simple batch workflows, progress/status checks, and export/download links.
- Designed for creators and marketers who want fast, streamlined edits without complex software.
